action.mutates: runs the check once as root (it runs Puppet's certregen healthcheck, which only reads); the output goes to /run/p8test-certhealth/out.txt

outcomes.outcome: the check script (the module's file, root 0755) and its dependency python3-yaml are installed
naemon may run the check as root through sudo, and the check refuses to run unprivileged
run as root, the check reports the certificates' expiry in Nagios form (OK, Warning or Critical with the certificate that expires first)
the thresholds (expired, 10 and 30 days) against a CA whose certificates expire at chosen dates

uncovered.why: the check cannot produce any expiry report on OpenVox 8 (puppet certregen is an unknown subcommand, measured on the agent node and on the master-role node), so the thresholds cannot be reached until the finding is resolved
uncovered.lifted_by: capability: a certificate-health source on OpenVox 8 (the finding's resolution), then a lab CA with certificates near expiry
